comments.author: @qwertyaqwertasd-g9g
comments.text: The views are incredible, but I would probably spend the entire night wondering whether the location was really safe. Adventure is exciting, but sleeping peacefully is another story.

replies.author: @VagariousTravel-868
replies.text: It’s definitely not for the faint of heart, and I think most people would feel that same mix of awe and anxiety! 😅

comments.author: @NoeliaNuñez-v9d
comments.text: Some people travel for comfort and relaxation, while others seem to search for the most extreme experiences possible. These hotels are definitely not for ordinary travelers.

comments.author: @danielyoon-y6b6c
comments.text: I have stayed in some unusual hotels, but nothing comes close to these incredible locations. The architecture, surroundings, and sheer courage required to build in such places are unbelievable. 🏗✨

replies.author: @VagariousTravel-868
replies.text: I couldn't agree more; the combination of human ingenuity and raw, unforgiving nature is what makes these places so unforgettable. ❤️

comments.author: @JFCamargo-y5d5u
comments.text: Imagine waking up to breathtaking views while knowing that the environment outside your window could be extremely dangerous. These hotels offer an experience that goes far beyond an ordinary vacation.

comments.author: @ZviMargaliot
comments.text: These hotels look absolutely unreal, but the fact that people actually stay in places surrounded by danger makes them even more fascinating. I can't decide whether I would be brave enough to spend a night in one of them
